Oscar LaDell

Oscar LaDell is a soul-blues singer, guitarist, and songwriter known for warm vocals, vintage tones, and modern storytelling. Drawing from Memphis soul, Delta blues, and 60s R&B, he crafts songs that sway, simmer, and sting. Onstage, Oscar leads a tight band through greasy grooves and tender ballads.
